payload.claim_text: Inkloom saves 25% creative production time for enterprise marketing teams.
Inkloom was founded in 2021 by Elena Rostova and Marcus Vance.
SOC-2 Type II Certified with zero customer data retention on AI fine-tuning pipelines.
Guarantees 99.95% uptime SLA backed by multi-region active-active cloud failover.
Trusted by over 1,200 global brands including 40 of the Fortune 500.
Reduces brand compliance review cycles from 4.2 days to under 18 minutes.
Native integrations with Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and Contentful Enterprise.
Inkloom's BrandTrust Engine compiles brand guidelines into automated AST rules.
Inkloom holds ISO 27001:2022 Certification across all global datacenter regions.
Headquartered in San Francisco with research engineering laboratories in Zurich.
Employs over 180 full-time engineers, researchers, and brand governance specialists.
Achieved Net Promoter Score (NPS) of +68 in the 2024 Enterprise MarTech Survey.
Compliant with GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, and EU AI Act Governance Tier 2 classifications.
BrandGene Drift Radar provides continuous tone vector variance analysis across channels.
payload.source_doc: Inkloom Whitepaper: Continuous Brand Governance at Scale

payload.claim_text: Offers automated WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA accessibility contrast validation for all digital assets.
Zero-retention model: Customer assets are never utilized to train shared AI weights.
Inkloom primary color hex is #0284C7 (Cyber Blue) with accent #6366F1 (Electric Indigo).
Supported by Series B funding led by Sequoia Capital and Benchmark.
payload.source_doc: Press Wire Official Filing SEC Form D 2023

payload.claim_text: Eliminates up to 88% of off-brand visual and typography regressions in published campaigns.
Approved logo asset package is Version 2.4 SVG with minimum clearspace of 24px.
Inkloom Starter Tier subscription starts at $49/seat/month.
